program:
app "Vacation" plane ocean
table flight route text, day date, cost money
table hotel name text, nights num 1.., cost money
table pack item text, packed bool
table doc name text, ready bool
setting trip_days num = 7
setting budget money = 600000 "Total budget"
let spent = sum(flight.cost) + sum(hotel.cost)
screen plan "Plan" plane
  goal spent, budget, "booked", ""
  "Budget per day" round(budget / trip_days) head
  "Left per day" round((budget - spent) / trip_days) faint
  list flight
  form flight, "Add flight"
  list hotel
  form hotel, "Add hotel"
screen packing "Packing" bag
  count(pack where packed = no) "left to pack" head
  each pack sort at as p
    row card swipe remove p
      toggle p.packed
      p.item grow
  form pack, "Add item"
screen docs "Documents" note
  each doc as d
    row card swipe remove d
      toggle d.ready
      d.name grow
  form doc, "Add document"
describe:
Vacation, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- flight: route: text; day: date; cost: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- hotel: name: text; nights: number, at least 1; cost: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- pack: item: text; packed: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- doc: name: text; ready: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: trip days: number, starts at 7; "Total budget": money, starts at 600000.
Works out:
- spent is the total cost of flight plus the total cost of hotel.
Shows:
- a screen "Plan":
  - spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "booked".
  - text: "Budget per day", budget divided by trip days rounded.
  - text: "Left per day", the result of budget minus spent divided by trip days rounded.
  - a list of flight; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
  - a form to add a flight.
  - a list of hotel; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
  - a form to add a hotel.
- a screen "Packing":
  - text: how many pack entries where packed is no, "left to pack".
  - for each pack sorted by at:
    - a group; a swipe removes the pack, with undo:
      - a tick box for the packed of the pack.
      - text: the item of the pack.
  - a form to add a pack.
- a screen "Documents":
  - for each doc:
    - a group; a swipe removes the doc, with undo:
      - a tick box for the ready of the doc.
      - text: the name of the doc.
  - a form to add a doc.

program:
app "Results Pro" school ocean
table class name text
table student name text, class ref class
table subject name text, class ref class, total num 1.. = 100
table result student ref student, subject ref subject, marks num 0..
each class as c
  stack card gap 1
    row
      c.name bold grow
      count(c.subject) "subjects" faint
    "Class average" round(avg(result.marks where student.class = c)) bold
each subject as sb
  sb.name sb.class.name head
  each result where subject = sb sort marks desc top 10 as r
    row card
      r.student.name bold grow
      r.marks
      round(100 * r.marks / sb.total) "%"
      if(r.marks * 100 / sb.total >= 80, "A", if(r.marks * 100 / sb.total >= 65, "B", if(r.marks * 100 / sb.total >= 50, "C", if(r.marks * 100 / sb.total >= 40, "D", "F"))))
form class, "Add class"
form student, "Add student"
form subject, "Add subject"
form result, "Enter marks"
describe:
Results Pro, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- class: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- student: name: text; class: a class. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- subject: name: text; class: a class; total: number, at least 1, starts at 100. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- result: student: a student; subject: a subject; marks: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each class:
  - text: the name of the class.
  - text: how many the class's subject entries, "subjects".
  - text: "Class average", the average marks of result where the class of the student is the class rounded.
- for each subject:
  - text: the name of the subject, the class name of the subject.
  - for each result where subject is the subject sorted by marks, highest first, first 10:
    - text: the student name of the result.
    - text: the marks of the result.
    - text: 100 times the marks of the result divided by the total of the subject rounded, "%".
    - text: "A" when the marks of the result times 100 divided by the total of the subject is at least 80, otherwise "B" when the marks of the result times 100 divided by the total of the subject is at least 65, otherwise "C" when the marks of the result times 100 divided by the total of the subject is at least 50, otherwise "D" when the marks of the result times 100 divided by the total of the subject is at least 40, otherwise "F".
- a form to add a class.
- a form to add a student.
- a form to add a subject.
- a form to add a result.

fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words

program:
app "Stock" package ink
table item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen
state q text = ""
let short = count(item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form item
remind "Check your items" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Stock, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the item have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "items running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each item where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the item for editing; a swipe removes the item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the item.
    - text: the kind of the item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the qty of the item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the qty of the item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the item.
- a form to add a item.
Reminder "Check your items" at 9:00 on Sat.
